description: Paul Savala's TRACE release provides training code and an anonymized subset of enrollment records for retraining and replicating grade and course prediction models at other institutions.
title: TRACE-grade-prediction training code and anonymized dataset release

description: Tracker is a free video analysis and modeling tool built on the Open Source Physics Java framework and distributed through the Open Source Physics project.
title: Tracker

description: TrackFX is a touch-tablet game-based multiple-object-tracking assessment developed by Kimiko Ryokai and colleagues to measure selective visual attention and tracking ability in children as young as 30 months.
title: TrackFX

description: A physical entrepreneurship simulation board game developed by Prihadi et al.
title: Traders Board Game (TBG)

description: A longitudinal dataset from the Transition and Innovation (TRAIN) study containing standardized mathematics and German achievement, subject interest, differentiated-instruction, and academic-orientation measures for students in German nonacademic-track secondary schools.
title: TRAIN longitudinal dataset (Grades 5-7, German nonacademic-track secondary schools)

description: Train(e)d is an on-demand virtual training platform created by the study authors that provides expert-led modules, case examples, interactive learning, and peer discussion for clinical evaluators assessing spinal muscular atrophy and other neuromuscular disorders.
title: Train(e)d

description: A 30-hour, six-module supervisor-training curriculum developed by Dyer for ESL-qualified instructors to help Australian workplace supervisors manage and train a multicultural workforce, including refugees and immigrants from non-English-speaking backgrounds.
title: Training a Multicultural Workforce

description: A 30-item self-report questionnaire measuring 15 facets of trait emotional intelligence grouped into Emotionality, Sociability, Well-Being, and Self-Control, developed by Petrides and colleagues.
title: Trait Emotional Intelligence Questionnaire (TEIQue, 30 items, four factors)

description: A Transcend-developed framework and accompanying primer and card deck that organize professional learning around individual variability, identity, motivation, and cognition.
title: Transcend's Designing for Learning framework

description: A 50-item multiple-choice physics assessment developed by Akinbobola to measure senior secondary students' transfer of knowledge from heat energy to sound and light energy concepts.
title: Transfer of Knowledge Test in Physics (TKTP)

description: A 30-item achievement test developed by Gül Kaleli Yılmaz to assess freshman pre-service primary school teachers' transformational-geometry knowledge through recognition, feature identification, and construction sections.
title: Transformational Geometry Achievement Test (TGAT)

description: A web-based classroom observation protocol developed for transitional bilingual, structured English immersion, and dual-language settings to record pedagogical and ESL instructional strategies.
title: Transitional Bilingual Observation Protocol (TBOP)

description: A corpus of 102 U.S.
title: TransplantQA corpus

description: A SAMHSA-grounded framework for organizing trauma-aware care through realizing and recognizing trauma, responding appropriately, and resisting retraumatization, used by healthcare and other service organizations.
title: Trauma-Informed Care (TIC)

description: A trauma-team workflow framework and associated checklist developed for multidisciplinary teams to coordinate reception and resuscitation during simulated and clinical trauma scenarios.
title: Trauma Team Time-out Model

description: A TraumaVision virtual-reality simulator module developed with Swemac Education for practicing and assessing short antegrade femoral nail osteosynthesis using haptic tools, simulated fluoroscopy, and performance metrics.

description: A researcher-completed observation checklist developed by Yalçınkaya for assessing whether case-based learning was implemented as intended, including grouping, teacher questioning, and participation criteria.

title: Treffinger's Self-Directed Learning Model

description: The TRENT index is a 33-item, three-point behavioural rating instrument developed by Ferguson et al.
title: TRENT index

description: TRIAD is a mathematics-intervention framework that links professional development, teacher knowledge, coaching, implementation fidelity, and child achievement in scaled-up pre-K and elementary implementations.
title: TRIAD

description: A Spanish-language trial version of the National Assessment of Educational Progress mathematics assessment administered by the National Center for Education Statistics to public-school students in grades 4 and 8 in Puerto Rico.
title: Trial Spanish-language NAEP mathematics assessment for Puerto Rico (2003 and 2005)

description: Tronclass is a visual online teaching platform developed by a university for distributing learning resources, administering tests, releasing scores, and supporting grading through web and mobile applications.
title: Tronclass (TC)

description: An 8-item Likert-scale questionnaire developed by Randler and colleagues to measure state disgust associated with trout dissection tasks in biology education.
title: Trout Disgust Scale
